typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	LoadtblCDBOCORSMTMPPE_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Column 3} as string,
		{Column 0} as string,
		{Column 2} as string,
		{Column 1} as string,
		{Column 4} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MTMMPEFlatFileSource
MTMMPEFlatFileSource sink(input(
		MPE as integer,
		TradeID as string,
		MTM as integer,
		Product as string,
		Officer as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MPE = {Column 3},
		TradeID = {Column 0},
		MTM = {Column 2},
		Product = {Column 1},
		Officer = {Column 4}),
	partitionFileNames:[($LoadtblCDBOCORSMTMPPE_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> LoadtblCDBOCORSMTMPPE
